mapper.update: UPDATE async_task SET status = 1, execute_node = #{executeNode}, execute_start_time = #{executeStartTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND status = 0 AND version = #{version} AND retry_count < max_retry

update.foreach: UPDATE async_task SET status = 1, execute_node = #{executeNode}, execute_start_time = #{executeStartTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskIds[${i}]} AND status = 0 AND version = #{versions[${i}]} AND retry_count < max_retry

mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE status = 0 AND retry_count < max_retry ORDER BY priority ASC, create_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task SET status = 2, result = #{result}, execute_end_time = #{executeEndTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}
UPDATE async_task SET status = 3, error_msg = #{errorMsg}, execute_end_time = #{executeEndTime}, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version}

UPDATE async_task SET status = 0, retry_count = retry_count + 1, execute_node = NULL, execute_start_time = NULL, execute_end_time = NULL, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version} AND retry_count < max_retry
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM async_task WHERE status = 1 AND execute_start_time IS NOT NULL AND DATE_ADD(execute_start_time, INTERVAL timeout_seconds SECOND) < NOW() ORDER BY execute_start_time ASC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE async_task SET status = 0, execute_node = NULL, execute_start_time = NULL, execute_end_time = NULL, retry_count = retry_count + 1, version = version + 1 WHERE id = #{taskId} AND version = #{version} AND retry_count < max_retry
mapper.select: SELECT status, COUNT(*) as count FROM async_task GROUP BY status

SELECT task_type, COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as success_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = 3 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as failed_count FROM async_task WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 24 HOUR) GROUP BY task_type
